deviations_from_impact_manifest: The frozen measurement_contract.schema.json carries additionalProperties:false on every object and has NO slot for cost provenance, control configuration, or an execution note. The first V2 draft used new keys (supersedes, supersedes_note, costs.source_manifest, costs.ontology_id, splits.execution_note, metrics.controls) and failed schema validation. Rather than amend a frozen schema, every statement was folded into the free-text field the schema does allow (costs.components[].bps_or_formula, exits.intrabar_rule, metrics.success_gate, authority.note). Nothing was dropped, and the manifest sha256 is still recomputed and verified at bind time.

Consequently the random_entry control seed is splits.seed (20260817, V1's own declared seed) rather than the 20260819 named in the first draft — the schema has no slot for a separate control seed. This changed only the random_entry draw; arms and long_only are deterministic and bit-identical across both runs.

LedgerRow was deliberately NOT extended (the impact manifest allowed either option). Split membership is recorded in split_manifest.json — which is what the contract asks for — and model ids in run-level provenance. This makes V1 byte-identity structural rather than something a compatibility path has to preserve.

src/research/visual_crt/measure.py was added (not named in the impact manifest's affected_files) to keep the runner a thin CLI wrapper per CLAUDE.md 3.3; controls.py alone would have forced orchestration into the script.
